title: Optional XAS metadata fields
description: Genuinely-optional XAS properties layered on cdifCore. Adds NO requirements. Documents and permits optional XAS content: (a) XAS data-array variables as schema:variableMeasured cdi:InstanceVariable items, and (b) optional beamline-operational and sample physico-chemical parameters carried as schema:additionalProperty entries (on the prov:used xas:Beamline entity and the schema:object sample respectively; see description.md for the propertyID vocabularies). Present only when the corresponding measurements exist.

@context.description: JSON-LD prefixes used by optional XAS fields.

schema:variableMeasured.description: Optional XAS data-array variables (energy, i0, itrans, ifluor, irefer, mutrans, mufluor, murefer, normtrans, normfluor, normrefer, chi, chi_re, chi_im, chi_mag, chi_pha, k, r, angle), each a cdi:InstanceVariable / schema:PropertyValue. Not required.
